capabilities_done: (1) corner pin in compositions (61c4ae7 + 1c585a9): additive SceneContent::Pinned(PinnedContent {content, pin: Projective2}) per the START_LOG decision's 'or nothing at all' route: no SceneLayer field, so its 29 construction sites are untouched; lower_scene resamples pinned tiles/static/precomp content through pin then matrix (pigment LayerTransform::projective). The composition adapter samples the Folio corner_pin stream with motion per tick and pins in layer space (content origin shift); composition_corner_pin refusal lifted (constant retired, kept). Typed refusals: composition_corner_pin_content (no own pixels / collapsed precomp), composition_corner_pin_on_document_graph.

(2) GPU keyer (b3c2a78): render-gpu key.wgsl (binary32) for chroma, luma, colour range, colour key, colour-difference, linear colour, extract, levels, choke/spread (r <= 32), feather (taps <= 129), edge smooth (r <= 16), despill, unmult; keyed tile layers are keyed on the device, read back, and the plan rewritten to a keyed tile (fresh key and hashes, keys removed); receipt digest/ledger are the original plan's; inner/outer, key cleaner, wire removal declared Unsupported; key_gpu_input / key_gpu_radius refused before device work.

(3) planar tracks as Folio mask paths (3cfbce1): StudioCompositionLayer.masks (serde default) = ordered StudioCompositionMask {mask_id, mode (7 STU-CMP-025a modes), inverted, closed, keyed path of 6 numbers per vertex}; track_apply::apply_planar_mask maps vertices and tangent handles through each tracked frame's homography; the adapter renders masks as a composition-space alpha matte (mask_paths: bezier through the layer matrix, nib exact-area coverage, ordered combination), so both renderers render them unchanged; masks + track matte / corner pin / document graph are typed refusals.

(4) serialisable tracker commands (570caaa): TrackerCommand / Nudge / NudgeStep live in pigment track_math with serde (internally tagged snake_case JSON, unknown fields refused; bar commands are empty struct variants so the refusal applies); composite re-exports them, no serde dependency added to composite.
